user_repository.User_query: Show data analyst openings with salary ranges and application totals.
user_repository.Graph_query: MATCH (p:Position)-[:FOR_ROLE]->(r:Role) WHERE r.name = "Data Analyst" RETURN p.title, p.salary_range, p.resume_count

user_repository.User_query: Which QA candidates have completed a technical interview?
user_repository.Graph_query: MATCH (c:Candidate)-[:APPLIED_TO]->(p:Position) WHERE p.position_id = "POSITION_002" AND c.interview_status = "Completed" RETURN c.email, c.interview_status

user_repository.User_query: Summarize the product designer offer pipeline.

user_repository.User_query: Find data engineering candidates with Airflow experience.
user_repository.Graph_query: MATCH (c:Candidate)-[:HAS_RESUME]->(r:Resume) WHERE r.primary_skills CONTAINS "Airflow" RETURN c.email

user_repository.User_query: List roles that are currently on hold.
user_repository.Graph_query: MATCH (p:Position) WHERE p.status = "On Hold" RETURN p.position_id, p.title

user_repository.User_query: Show upcoming interviews scheduled for this month.
user_repository.Graph_query: MATCH (c:Candidate) WHERE c.interview_date >= "11/16/2026" RETURN c.email, c.interview_date

user_repository.User_query: Review cloud security positions and their interview status.

user_repository.User_query: Which UX research positions have been filled?
